policy.target: pace-to-limit: planned_use(t) = limit * safety * elapsed_fraction(window). safety=0.95 leaves a 5% overrun margin.
policy.weight: routing multiplier = clamp(remaining / (limit*safety*(1-elapsed)), 0, 1.5); 0 when remaining <= 5% of limit or the live source reports 429/402/exhausted.
policy.unverified: limit=null means no fetched page states it for this account; the poller then relies on live readings only and never invents a number.

services.documented: GitHub Actions usage is free for public repositories using standard GitHub-hosted runners. Larger runners are always charged.
services.live: none needed; guard: never use larger runners

services.reset: eviction by last access; unused caches deleted after 7 days
services.documented: 10 GB per repository by default; beyond 10 GB is billed.
1,000 requests per hour per repository (GITHUB_TOKEN); 5,000/hour for a user token.

services.live: GET api.vercel.com/v6/deployments?since=now-24h (VERCEL_TOKEN). Known gap: read 87 while Vercel enforced the cap (2026-10-19 02:16 PDT), so treat <=95 as free.

services.documented: Maximum Build Step duration is 45 minutes. Hobby always uses the Basic build machine (2 vCPU, 8 GB).
Hobby: 500 included Starter minutes. With no payment method or the spend limit reached, Render stops pipeline tasks for the rest of the month; services stay active on existing build artifacts.
services.live: Not in the Render API (dashboard Billing > Monthly Included Usage only). Proxy: count of deploys this month via GET /v1/services/{id}/deploys?createdAfter=; build log text 'run out of build pipeline minutes'.

services.documented: 750 Free instance hours per workspace per month; running services use them, spun-down services do not; when exhausted all Free web services are suspended until next month. Spin-down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic.
services.live: Dashboard only. Upper bound: free web services x hours in month (1 service = max 744 h < 750).

services.documented: Hobby: 5 GB bandwidth included. Without a payment method, exhausting it suspends all Free services for the rest of the month.

services.window: 30 days from creation + 14 days grace, then deleted
services.documented: One free Postgres per workspace, 1 GB, expires 30 days after creation, deleted after 14-day grace. Free Key Value: one per workspace, in-memory only, data lost on restart.
Free: 100 projects, 100 CU-hours/project, 1 GB storage per project (20 GB total), 5 GB egress.
1 GB per project, up to 20 GB across projects.
Free-model RPM and RPD limits depend on credits purchased (all time). The key endpoint reports the daily counter and ceiling.

services.metric: RPM / TPM / RPD per model, per project
services.documented: Limits apply per project, not per key; RPD resets at midnight Pacific; values vary per model.
Copilot Free includes limited access; exact allowances not extracted from the fetched page.
Templated zero-token providers in multi-ai-cli/vendors; no published quota. Treat 429/retry-after as the limit.
Free-tier stacks are hard-limited at defaults (e.g. ingestion_rate 10,000 samples/s); monthly allowances not extracted.
Referral lanes from docs/PARTNERS.md section 1; not usage quotas.
